LI Yun, CHEN Xiao-ping\* (Institute of Clinical Pharmacology, Central South University, Changsha 410078)Abstract: Danshen (Salvia miltiorrhiza), a traditional Chinese herbal medicine, is clinically used for the adjuvant therapy of cardiovascular diseases. The active ingredients of Danshen are complicated, and some of them play signifi - cant roles in the impact of cytochrome P450 isozyme activity in the liver and may be relevant to potential herb-drug interactions. It is meaningful to discuss the effect of Danshen on P450 isozyme activity and the mechanism of herbdrug interactions when Danshen is used with other agents in clinical practice.Key words: Salvia miltiorrhiza monomer;
